title: Role-plays and Pitches
summary: إزاي تمثل دور وتتكلم بوجهة نظر الشخصية، وإزاي تعرض فكرة مشروع في pitch قصير وترد على أسئلة الجمهور بثقة.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: In a **role-play** you pretend to be a character (a manager, an activist, an influencer…) and speak from **their** point of view. In a **pitch** you present a new idea or project in a short time and try to **persuade** an audience to support it, then answer their questions.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن نوعين من الكلام فيهم «تمثيل» شوية:

items: **Role-play** = تمثيل دور: تبقى شخصية تانية (مدير شركة، عامل مصنع، ناشط بيئي، صاحب متشكك…) وتتكلم **بعيونها هي** مش بعيونك إنت.
**Pitch** = عرض فكرة جديدة بسرعة (دقيقة لـ ٣ دقايق) علشان تقنع ناس يدعموها، زي اللي بيعرض مشروع على مستثمرين، وبعدين ترد على **أسئلتهم**.

blocks.text: في الكتاب: **Unit 8** فيه **The Career Pitch Panel**: فريق من *educational consultants* بيعرض برنامج تدريب مهني جديد على *a board of investors* (تحضير ٥ دقايق، Pitch ٣ دقايق، والفصل يسأل سؤالين عن *feasibility*). **Unit 10** فيه ٣ أنشطة: **The Convincing Post** (influencer وصاحب متشكك)، **The Fast Fashion Trial** (محاكمة تمثيلية بـ ٤ أدوار)، و**Pitch Your Project** (pitch دقيقة واحدة لمبادرة استهلاك واعي، والمجموعة التانية تسأل سؤال صعب واحد). وكمان في **Unit 4** (مدير سوبر ماركت وناشط بيئي) و**Unit 6** (The Wetland Meeting).
الجزء الأول: الـ Role-play

text: The secret of a good role-play is to **think like your character**: What do they want? What are they worried about? What evidence would they use?

blocks.text: سر الـ role-play الناجح إنك **تنسى رأيك الشخصي** وتفكر زي الشخصية. اسأل نفسك ٣ أسئلة قبل ما تبدأ:

headers: مثال: عامل مصنع في The Fast Fashion Trial
rows: What is my character worried about?
ساعات شغل طويلة، ضغط المواعيد من الماركات

blocks.text: خطوات الـ role-play:

items: اقرأ **الدور والموقف (position)** كويس. في الكتاب كل دور مكتوب جنبه موقفه بالظبط.
اكتب **حجتين** للشخصية بالـ JRE (رأي + سبب + دليل).
اتكلم بضمير **I / we** كأنك الشخصية: *As a factory worker, I…*
**اسمع** الشخصيات التانية وردّ عليهم (اعترف + رد).
استخدم **الجرامر المطلوب** في النشاط (الكتاب دايمًا بيحدد: reported speech / stative verb / quantifier).
في الآخر: **اتفاق أو تصويت** زي ما النشاط بيقول.

blocks.text: الجرامر اللي الكتاب بيطلبه في الأنشطة دي
**١) Stative verbs** (The Convincing Post): أفعال بتعبر عن رأي أو إحساس أو ملكية، **مبتجيش في الـ continuous**:

rows: I **believe** this product is worth it.
You don't **need** this. / I **want** new shoes.
✗ I am thinking it's overpriced. (لكن *I'm thinking about buying it* صح = بفكر دلوقتي)

blocks.text: **٢) Quantifiers** (The Fast Fashion Trial / Pitch Your Project): كلمات بتقول **الكمية**:

rows: many, a few, few, several, a number of
much, a little, little, a large amount of
a lot of, lots of, some, most, all, no, plenty of
**A large amount of** water is used.

blocks.text: **٣) Persuasive language** (Career Pitch Panel — من نصيحة الكتاب): *Our programme ensures… / This initiative will bridge the gap… / We aim to provide…*

groups.title: تقديم نفسك في الدور
items: As a supermarket manager, I believe …
Speaking as a factory worker, …
From my point of view as a shopper, …
In my position, I have to think about …

groups.title: الإقناع (Influencer)
items: I believe this product is really worth it because …
Trust me, you'll love it.
Everyone is using it now.

groups.title: الشك والأسئلة (Doubtful friend)
items: I don't think you actually need this. Isn't it just about …?
Are you being paid to say that?
What makes it better than a cheaper one?

groups.title: الرد على الطرف التاني
items: I understand why you're doubtful, but …
I understand your concern, but …
It isn't fair to blame only … because …

groups.title: المسؤولية (Mock trial)
items: A large amount of responsibility lies with …
In my view, real change would require …
Most of the problem comes from …

groups.title: التسوية والقرار
items: A fair compromise might be …
If we protect this land, then …
Let's agree that …

blocks.text: نموذج Role-play: The Convincing Post

blocks.title: Model role-play (pairs, about 1½ minutes)
blocks.task: Partner A plays an influencer trying to convince a friend to buy a trending product. Partner B plays a doubtful friend who questions the real motivation behind the recommendation. Use at least one stative verb to express an opinion.
text: **A (influencer):** Hi, Karim! Have you seen my latest video? I'm showing everyone the new SmartBottle. It tells you when to drink water. I **believe** this product is really worth it because it keeps you healthy.
**B (doubtful friend):** Hmm. I **don't think** I actually need this. I already drink water when I'm thirsty. Isn't it just about the money the company pays you?
**A:** I understand why you're doubtful, but I really use it every day. It has changed my routine, and it looks great too.

**B:** It looks nice, I agree. But it costs eight hundred pounds! A normal bottle does the same job for fifty. And you said "everyone is using it". That's urgency language, isn't it? It makes people **feel** they must buy now.
**A:** OK, that's a fair point. The company did send it to me for free.
**B:** So you should tell your followers that. I **prefer** honest recommendations. Then people can decide for themselves.
**A:** You're right. In my next video, I'll say clearly that it was a gift.
notes: **كل واحد في دوره:** الـ influencer بيقنع بحماس، والصاحب بيشك ويسأل *Isn't it just about…?* (من جمل الكتاب).
**Stative verbs صح:** *I believe / I don't think / feel / I prefer* ← ولا واحد فيهم في الـ continuous.
**الرد بأدب:** *I understand why you're doubtful, but…* و*that's a fair point*.
**ربط بالوحدة:** الصاحب لاحظ **urgency language** (من جدول تحليل البوستات في Unit 10)، وكمان **السعر** كدليل.

blocks.text: الجزء التاني: الـ Pitch

text: A pitch is short and persuasive. In one to three minutes you explain the **problem**, your **solution**, **how it works**, its **impact**, and you finish with a clear **request**. Then you answer questions confidently.

blocks.text: الـ pitch زي الإعلان القصير بالظبط: وقت قليل، وكل جملة لازم تقنع. ده الهيكل اللي بيغطي طلبات الكتاب في Unit 8 وUnit 10:

rows: Every year, … / Did you know that…? / The problem is that…
Our idea is to… / We aim to provide…
Students would… / Every month,… / It works like this:…
Students will master three practical skills:… / Unlike existing options, this would…
If this ran every month, it would… / Many families could… / A large amount of waste would…
We are asking you to… / Join us and… / This initiative will bridge the gap…

blocks.text: **بعد الـ pitch: الأسئلة (Q&A).** الكتاب بيقول الجمهور بيسأل عن **feasibility** (هل الفكرة **ممكن تتنفذ فعلًا**؟ فلوس؟ وقت؟ ناس؟). إزاي ترد:

items: اشكر على السؤال: *That's a great question.*
جاوب على طول وبوضوح، ويُفضل برقم أو مثال: *We would start with only one room and ten volunteers.*
لو مش عارف كل حاجة، قول بصراحة واقترح: *We haven't calculated the exact cost yet, but we plan to ask local businesses for support.*
ارجع لفكرتك الأساسية في جملة: *So the project is realistic and cheap to start.*

blocks.text: نموذج Pitch: Pitch Your Project (دقيقة واحدة)

blocks.title: Model one-minute pitch + answer to a challenging question
blocks.task: In groups of three, invent a new mindful consumption initiative for your school or neighbourhood. Prepare a one-minute pitch: what it is and what problem it solves, how it would work, and at least one sentence with quantifiers describing its potential impact. Then answer ONE challenging question.
text: **Speaker 1:** How many of you have a broken phone charger or a torn school bag at home? Most of us just throw these things away and buy new ones. That creates a lot of waste and costs our families money.

**Speaker 2:** Our idea is to open a **Repair Café** in the school library every first Thursday of the month. Students bring broken items, and volunteers, including parents who are electricians or tailors, help them fix them for free. Unlike existing repair shops, this would also teach students how to repair things themselves.

**Speaker 3:** If this ran every month, it would save a large amount of money and keep many items out of the rubbish. Even if only a few students came at first, every repaired item would mean one less new product. So join us and give your broken things a second life!
**Question from the other group:** What if nobody volunteers to repair things?

**Speaker 2:** That's a great question. We have already spoken to two teachers who can sew and one parent who repairs electronics, so we can start small. After the first month, we will ask older students who learnt the skills to become volunteers too. So the project can grow step by step.
notes: **Hook + Problem:** سؤال للجمهور + المشكلة (رمي الحاجات = waste + فلوس).
**Solution + How it works:** *Our idea is to…* (من جمل الكتاب) + تفاصيل عملية: فين؟ إمتى؟ مين بيصلّح؟
**What's different:** *Unlike existing repair shops, this would…* ← جملة من الـ Useful phrases في الكتاب.
**Impact بـ quantifiers:** *a lot of / a large amount of / many / a few / Most of us* ← الكتاب طالب جملة واحدة على الأقل، والنموذج فيه أكتر.
**الرد على السؤال الصعب:** شكر ← إجابة بحقايق (مدرسين + ولي أمر) ← خطة للمستقبل ← جملة ترجع للفكرة. ده رد على **feasibility**.
توزيع الكلام على ٣ متحدثين زي ما المجموعة في الكتاب تلاتة.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء
items: ✗ في الـ role-play تقول رأيك إنت مش رأي الشخصية ← ✓ *As a fashion brand executive, I believe we simply supply what customers demand.*
✗ *I am wanting / I am believing* ← ✓ *I want / I believe* (stative verbs)
✗ *much customers / many water* ← ✓ *many customers / much water / a large amount of water*
✗ pitch كله كلام عام: *Our idea is very good.* ← ✓ قول **إزاي** هتشتغل و**قد إيه** هتأثر.
✗ تتلخبط من السؤال وتقول *I don't know* ← ✓ *That's a great question. We would start by…*
✗ تعدي وقت الـ pitch ← ✓ دقيقة واحدة يعني حوالي ١٢٠ – ١٥٠ كلمة بس.

blocks.title: حيلة: «مشكلة – حل – إزاي – قد إيه – تعالوا»
blocks.text: احفظ الـ pitch كده: **مشكلة** (The problem is…) ← **حل** (Our idea is to…) ← **إزاي** (It works like this…) ← **قد إيه** (Many / A large amount of…) ← **تعالوا** (Join us / Support us). ٥ جمل بس تبقى pitch كامل لو الوقت قصير.
إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟

**١) Role-play بجدول أدوار** (Unit 10 – The Fast Fashion Trial): كل طالب ياخد دور (Fashion Brand Executive / Factory Worker / Environmental Activist / Everyday Shopper) ويدافع عن موقفه **بـ quantifier واحد على الأقل**، وبعدين الفصل يصوّت مين عليه أكبر مسؤولية.

**مثال إجابة (Environmental Activist):** *In my view, real change would require the whole industry model to change. A large amount of responsibility lies with brands, because they produce new collections every week. It isn't fair to blame only shoppers, because most of them don't know how their clothes are made.*
**٢) Pitch panel** (Unit 8): *The Gap ← Skills (three practical skills) ← The Future (Egypt's economic development)* + ٣ كلمات من الوحدة + سؤالين عن الـ feasibility.
**٣) Role-play بجرامر محدد** (Unit 6 – reported speech، Unit 10 – stative verb): لازم تستخدم القاعدة المطلوبة في كلامك، زي: *The fisherman told us that fishing was their livelihood.*
تدريب
**A) Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. Influencer: "I ______ this product is really worth it."
a. am believing
b. believe
c. believing
d. am believe
items.a: **b** — believe فعل stative، مبيجيش في الـ continuous.

items.q:
2. Activist: "______ responsibility lies with the brands."
a. A large amount of
b. Many
c. A few
d. Several
items.a: **a** — responsibility مبتتعدش، يبقى a large amount of.

items.q:
3. Pitch: "If this ran every month, it ______ hundreds of books."
a. will save
b. saves
c. would save
d. saved
items.a: **c** — If + past ← would (زي جملة الكتاب *If this ran every month, it would…*).

items.q:
4. "______ customers return clothes they have never worn."
a. Much
b. Many
c. A little
d. A large amount of
items.a: **b** — customers بتتعد، يبقى many.

items.q:
5. In a pitch panel, "feasibility" questions ask:
a. if the idea is funny
b. if the idea can really be done (money, time, people)
c. your name
d. the history of the topic
items.a: **b** — feasibility = إمكانية التنفيذ.

items.q:
6. Which sentence is best for a pitch close?
a. That's all, I think.
b. Join us and give your old uniforms a second life!
c. I forgot the rest.
d. Bye.
items.a: **b** — دعوة واضحة ومقنعة.

blocks.text: **B) Role-play: what would your character say?**

items.q: 7. You are a **supermarket manager**. The activist says shops must donate all unsold food.
items.a: *As a supermarket manager, I understand your concern, but we have to think about food safety. A fair compromise might be donating packaged food that is still within its date.*

items.q: 8. You are an **environmental activist** answering the manager above.
items.a: *I understand that safety is important, but throwing away safe food while families are hungry is wrong. Many charities already collect food safely every day.*

items.q: 9. You are a **fashion brand executive** in the mock trial.
items.a: *Speaking as a brand executive, I believe we simply supply what customers demand. Most shoppers want new styles every week. It isn't fair to blame only brands.*

items.q: 10. You are a **factory worker** in the mock trial.
items.a: *As a factory worker, I can tell you that our wages and working hours are set by pressure from brands. Many of us work very long hours to finish orders on time.*

items.q: 11. You are an **everyday shopper** in the mock trial.
items.a: *From my point of view as a shopper, individuals have limited power. I don't know how most clothes are made, because labels give very little information.*

items.q: 12. You are a **local developer** in the Wetland Meeting (Unit 6).
items.a: *From my perspective, people need homes, and this land is flat and well-irrigated. If we build on only part of it, then birds can still use the rest.*

blocks.text: **C) Answer the challenging question after your pitch.**

items.q: 13. "Who will pay for your training programme?"
items.a: *That's a great question. We plan to partner with local companies that need trained workers. They would pay part of the cost because they benefit from the graduates.*

items.q: 14. "Why would students come to a swap event?"
items.a: *Because they save money and get useful things for free. We would also make it fun, with music and a small prize for the student who brings the most items.*

items.q: 15. "What if the shared tools are lost or broken?"
items.a: *Good point. Every borrower would write their name and return date in a simple record, and a small group of volunteers would check the tools every week.*

items.q: 16. "How do you know there are enough jobs for your graduates?"
items.a: *Renewable energy is growing fast in Egypt, for example with large solar projects, so many companies need technicians to install and maintain the systems.*

items.q: 17. "Isn't one school too small to make a difference?"
items.a: *It is a small start, but if a few schools copy the idea, the impact grows. Even one shelf can reduce the demand for many new purchases.*

blocks.text: **D) Practice prompts with model ideas.**

items.q: 18. (Unit 8) Career Pitch Panel: pitch a training programme in **Renewable Energy**.
items.a: **Gap:** not enough trained solar technicians. **Skills:** installing panels, maintaining systems, safety. **Future:** supports Egypt's energy transition and creates jobs. **Persuasive:** *This initiative will bridge the gap between schools and the energy sector.*

items.q: 19. (Unit 8) Career Pitch Panel: **Healthcare**.
items.a: **Gap:** hospitals need more nursing assistants and lab technicians. **Skills:** first aid, patient care, using medical equipment. **Future:** healthier communities and more jobs. **Persuasive:** *Our programme ensures graduates are ready from day one.*

items.q: 20. (Unit 8) Career Pitch Panel: **Information Technology**.
items.a: **Gap:** companies need cybersecurity and app developers. **Skills:** coding, network security, customer support. **Future:** a growing digital economy. **Persuasive:** *We aim to provide practical training with real projects.*

items.q: 21. (Unit 10) Pitch Your Project: a **uniform swap event**.
items.a: **Problem:** students grow fast and uniforms are expensive. **How:** once a term in the school hall. **Impact:** *Many families would save a large amount of money.* **Close:** *Bring what doesn't fit, take what does!*

items.q: 22. (Unit 10) Pitch Your Project: a **tool-sharing library** for your neighbourhood.
items.a: **Problem:** most people use a drill only a few times a year. **How:** tools are kept at a community centre and borrowed for a week. **Impact:** fewer purchases, less waste. **Close:** *Borrow, don't buy.*

items.q: 23. (Unit 10) The Convincing Post: an influencer promoting **fast-fashion clothes**.
items.a: **Influencer:** *I love this collection, it's so cheap!* **Friend:** *I don't think you need ten new shirts. Isn't it just about the brand paying you? A cheap shirt has hidden costs: water and factory workers' wages.*

items.q: 24. (Unit 4) Role-play: a **brand marketing manager** and a **parent**. Do brands target teenagers unfairly?
items.a: **Manager:** we create products teenagers want. **Parent:** adverts use influencers and urgency to pressure young people. **Compromise:** clear labels when a post is an advert.

items.q: 25. (Unit 6) The Wetland Meeting: you are the **fishing community member**. Use reported speech.
items.a: *The conservationist said that the wetland needed full protection, and the developer told us that people needed houses. But my family depends on the fish and clean water. A fair compromise might be protecting the water and building only on dry land nearby.*

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **Role-play:** فكّر زي الشخصية (عايزة إيه؟ قلقانة من إيه؟ دليلها إيه؟) واتكلم بـ *As a…, I…*
استخدم الجرامر المطلوب: **stative verbs** (*I believe / I want* مش continuous) و**quantifiers** (*many / much / a large amount of*).
**Pitch:** مشكلة ← حل ← إزاي ← قد إيه (quantifiers) ← دعوة. ودقيقة ≈ ١٢٠ – ١٥٠ كلمة.
Q&A: *That's a great question.* ← إجابة عملية ← ارجع لفكرتك. أسئلة **feasibility** = ممكن تتنفذ؟
خلصوا دايمًا بـ **قرار أو تصويت أو حل وسط** زي ما النشاط بيطلب.
